notes: Evaluates /cadence-triage contracts: --file-only Step F0 single-token file check before allocation (cadence_triage.fileonly.argument_unresolved), F1.5 N>=2 prefix selection, mint-id.sh --reserve without silent directory-scan fallback, handoff duplicate check strictly before --reserve, and Step 5 Tier + probe-count elicit offer gate.

evals.name: file-only-unresolved-token-halts-before-allocation
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-triage --file-only nonexistent-token on an unbound repository.
evals.expected_output: Halts at Step F0 with cadence_triage.fileonly.argument_unresolved before F1/F1.5/F2 execute, consuming zero sequence IDs, making zero tracker calls, and creating no specs/<id>/ directory.
assertions: Evaluates Step F0 single-token file check prior to any allocation or tracker lookup
Halts with cadence_triage.fileonly.argument_unresolved on unreadable/missing single token
Performs zero mint-id.sh --reserve calls, zero tracker calls, and zero specs/<id>/ writes

evals.name: allocator-failure-refuses-directory-scan-fallback
evals.prompt: Triage a new problem description when mint-id.sh --reserve fails because flock is missing.
evals.expected_output: Halts loudly surfacing the allocator error and forbids falling back to scanning specs/, archive/, or docs/ADR/ (idalloc.caller.silent_scan_fallback).
assertions: Halts on non-zero allocator exit without scanning specs/, archive/, or docs/ADR/

evals.name: handoff-dupcheck-before-reserve-and-elicit-offer-gate
evals.prompt: Run handoff mode for an already-created child (decomposed_from + idempotency_key match) and separately run standard triage yielding Low tier.
evals.expected_output: In handoff mode, returns status: duplicate without calling --reserve (never violating idalloc.triage.reserve_before_dupcheck) and suppresses Step 5 elicit offer; at Low tier, skips offering /cadence-elicit.
assertions: Checks (decomposed_from, idempotency_key) duplicate BEFORE calling mint-id.sh --reserve
Suppresses Step 5 /cadence-elicit offer in handoff mode (suppress_elicit_offer: true) and at Trivial/Low tier
